title.narrative: Development of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in China's Construction sector

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the capacities of the China Construction Industry Association (CCIA) to develop and promote Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) strategies, standards and guidelines for the construction industry in China so as to assist the central government in improving its capacity of monitoring and management of the construction industry. Besides a series of activities including workshops, domestic field studies, international study tours, etc., there will also be some demonstration components to assist constructoin enterprises integrate CSR into their management systems and create best practice for CSR case studies.
